pr_title: Remove incompatible button entities for Mazda electric vehicles
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.

In the Mazda integration, the Mazda API does not support start engine, stop engine, and hazard lights functionality for electric vehicles. Therefore this PR removes those entities for only those vehicles. I don't believe this is a breaking change since those entities were already non-functional, but let me know if I'm incorrect.

Hi @ridderr,
Thanks for the report. I haven't heard of anyone testing this integration with a CX-60 before, so it's possible the issue could be specific to that model.
A few questions:
1. Is your vehicle fully electric, plug-in hybrid, or gas-only?
2. Do the other functions, such as the sensor entities and climate/charging switch (if electric), work correctly in HA?
3. For the functions that aren't working in HA, are you able to successfully perform those same functions using the MyMazda mobile app?
I'm having the exact same issue with my cx30 model 2022.
@alireza-hosseini and anyone else who is having this issue, can you provide answers to the above questions please? This would help with troubleshooting the issue.

> Hi @ridderr, Thanks for the report. I haven't heard of anyone testing this integration with a CX-60 before, so it's possible the issue could be specific to that model. A few questions:
> 
> 1. Is your vehicle fully electric, plug-in hybrid, or gas-only? **No it's an hibrid**
> 2. Do the other functions, such as the sensor entities and climate/charging switch (if electric), work correctly in HA? **Yes, these are working fine**
> 3. For the functions that aren't working in HA, are you able to successfully perform those same functions using the MyMazda mobile app? **yes, Locking the door is working, but putting on/off harazds lights (and other) aren't supported by (the very poor) mobile app.**

@bdr99 Hi Brandon did you had time to look into this?

Hi @ridderr, sorry for the delay. You should be able to lock the door in HA but not unlock it. Unfortunately, any functionality that is not available in the Mazda app will also not be available in the HA integration. This is a limitation on Mazda's side and there's nothing we can do about it. I will be updating the HA integration to remove the non-functional entities for electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles (see #95486).

Good idea. I just added tests for that.
